focus.name: level-palette-source-extents
focus.purpose: Bound the level-selected four-band palette sources published by the active-level transition service.

service.name: Scene_ApplyActiveLevelPaletteTransition
service.contract: Loads the active LEVEL_TABLE palette pointer and passes it to a helper that consumes four 16-word bands.

evidence: Scene_ApplyActiveLevelPaletteTransition multiplies SCENE_STATE by the 0x42-byte LEVEL_TABLE stride and reads the palette pointer at record offset 0x20.
Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom publishes and consumes exactly four 16-word source bands, establishing a 0x80-byte extent for each unique pointer.
The 13 records resolve to 11 unique pointers; state 00/02 and state 05/06 share sources, while the existing 0x00129332 interaction palette bank is the first band of state 07.
limitations: The four bands are not split into individual semantic color roles.
The state-07 source is represented by its existing first-band symbol plus a separately owned 0x60-byte remainder to avoid duplicate symbol addresses.
